> S234 (full /audit→/implement arc) — full-website redundancy+freshness pass found 233 sessions of per-surface gates had let 4 visitor-facing truths drift cross-surface: wrong Obelisk auth-return domain (vaultspark.studio≠canonical, broke login on both entry points), retired sealed:7 vocab, gold-vs-blue tier-theme contradiction, 277-day-stale 393 days-since-launch.
